giver: Anybody costing a closed system who has quoted one number for the whole of it.
object: Take a system you are costing and sort its inputs into what must arrive, what can be made in place, and what is already there.
done: Every input is in exactly one pile, and the pile marked "must arrive" has a mass on it.
note: The one quest with a prerequisite, and it is a real one: you cannot sort inputs by origin until you have drawn the boundary they cross.
